title: Kosi and Nepal rivers, September 2024
caption: None of the 14 districts later named in reports was at Warning from 8 to 22 September. Rain forecasts put 11 at Warning on the 23rd and all 14 on the 24th, four days before the first report on the 28th. The same replay shows a failure: the Ganga flood reported on 22 September got no warning 3 to 7 days ahead in any of its 7 districts.

title: Ganga, September 2026
caption: The Ganga read 50.53 m at Patna on 5 September, against a danger mark of 48.60 m. 6 of the 12 named districts were at Warning at least 3 days before they were first reported. Ten had been flagged on 28 August, and the alert lapsed before the flood arrived.

title: North Bihar, August 2017
caption: A flood from the training years, replayed by a model that never saw 2015 to 2017. Rain forecasts are not used here, because the archive starts in 2024.
